blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Team Philippines’ Victoria Bossong settled for bronze in the athetics women’s 800-meter final of the Asian Games 2026 on Tuesday at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium. Bossong, who made his debut in the continental meet, finished the race in two minutes and 5.34 seconds, good for third place. “I wish I could be here with a gold medal, but I gave it my best today, and I’m just happy I was able to bring home a medal for the Philippines,” she said. “I hope next […]...
